name: Detailed Addon Evaluation Logging
objective: Provide clear, consistent evaluation diagnostics in Blender system console for addon actions and feature execution paths.
exit_criteria: Console output includes addon-prefixed logs for each major user action path.
Logs include evaluated action name, sanitized inputs/context, decision/result, and failure reason when applicable.
When behavior is unexpected without an exception, logs include evaluative state transitions for diagnosis.
Logging format is consistent across operators and core functions and documented for contributors.
Requester confirms debug output is clear, useful, and sufficient for troubleshooting before archive.
